items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Well maybe Lee Kelly come into the Court of Two Sisters when Tony and I was working in the courtyard place

ctx.x: The Oriental Foxtrot Orchestra. And they do all those numbers like Dardanella and as well as a lot of the local numbers. They do Purple, Rosa, Cairo sometimes.
Well maybe Lee Kelly come into the Court of Two Sisters when Tony and I was working in the courtyard place, I don't know what they... What was it called?
Huh? That room we were in. Jimmy Cooper built that little place in the back. You're talking about the place on Bourbon? Yeah.
